bio: With its classic French bistro charm, Bistro de Yountville feels like a slice of France transported into the heart of the city. The cozy and inviting atmosphere evokes the essence of the French countryside, while the cuisine by Chefs Tommy Lee and Jae-hyung Park reflects their dedication to the fundamentals of French cooking, infused with meticulous care and unwavering effort. The restaurant’s name pays homage to Yountville, the home of the famed French Laundry in California’s Napa Valley, where the chefs were inspired to recreate their unforgettable experiences for diners. Savoring the thoughtfully prepared dishes and warm ambiance here offers a delightful escape from the hustle and bustle of city life....
